supplement.provenance: Run/commit supplied by the lead; downloaded XML/log hashes verified locally. Cancelled shard supplemented, not certified as a successful CI run.

method: Sum JUnit case times by collected file, with a 0.001-second floor. These are scheduling estimates, not wall-clock predictions or a test allowlist. Untimed collected files use the median known duration; obsolete entries are ignored. Missing-shard observations use elapsed time between consecutive results on each CI worker (first result measured from pytest session start; includes setup, prior teardown and scheduling delay). Unfinished cases use completed local JUnit times listed in source.supplement. Unmeasured prior entries retain their exact values.
